title: Frailty transition and burden on mortality risk in middle-aged and older population: a prospective cohort study.
figures: Kaplan-Meier curves for the incidence of death according to frailty transition.

Associations between the burden of pre-frailty or frailty during follow-up and risk of death. The burden of pre-frailty or frailty was defined as the proportion of visits with a frailty index > 1 (pre-frail or frail) during follow-up based on the number of visits.
tables: Characteristics at the first and last visits according to frailty status.
Association between mortality and frailty index.
